pizza.line: I'll go. But I'm not happy about the cheese overshadowing me. Again.

stirfry.line: FINALLY. Someone who respects my crunch. Happy little tree noises.

salad.line: Of course I'm in the salad. Where else would I be? I'm the responsible one.

smoothie.line: You want to BLEND me?? I have a FAMILY. I have a STEM.

burger.line: So I'm the healthy topping. Cool. Cool cool cool. Love being decorative.

pizza.line: LET'S GOOOOO! Pizza night! I bring the COLOR, baby!

stirfry.line: STIRFRY GANG! Wok it up! I'm the star of this show!

salad.line: Salad's cool, salad's cool. I add the CRUNCH. The VIBE.

smoothie.line: Blended?! You're blending the FUN out of me, man!

burger.line: Burger toppings UNITE! I'm the spicy one, obviously.

pizza.line: Oh! Pizza? I mean, if you want me there. I don't want to impose.

stirfry.line: Stirfry is nice. Quiet. Everyone minds their own business. I like that.

salad.line: Raw? In a SALAD? Do you know how exposed that feels?

smoothie.line: Absolutely not. I'm not being blended. I'm not. Please don't.

burger.line: Burger's fine. I'll just sit here. In the corner. Between the patty and cheese.

pizza.line: Pizza! Fun! Wait, am I supposed to be here? Is this a thing people do?

stirfry.line: STIRFRY BEST FRY! I pop with joy! Literally pop! Get it? Corn pops!

salad.line: Salad! Yay! I'm the sweet one! Every salad needs a sweet one!

smoothie.line: Oh we're blending? Okay! That's okay. I trust you.

burger.line: On a burger? Sure! I'll just roll with it. Corn always rolls with it.

pizza.line: Pizza. With me on it. Bold creative choice. Hope it works out for you.

stirfry.line: Sure, stirfry me. I'll just quietly become mush. Cool.

salad.line: Finally. Someone who gets me. Salad. As it should be.

smoothie.line: Blend me. I'm 96% water. You're basically drinking a fancy glass of me.

burger.line: On a burger. Sure. Why not. Put me next to a slab of beef. Real dignified.

pizza.line: In my day, pizza was just bread and tomatoes. You kids put everything on it.

stirfry.line: Stirfry. Now THAT is a dignified use of a leafy elder. Respect.

salad.line: Naturally. I am the original salad. I was salad before salad was cool.

smoothie.line: I have been on this earth for millennia. And you blend me. Wonderful.

burger.line: Under the patty. As a slaw. I've seen worse fates. Barely.

pizza.line: Pizza crust?! Wait, is this my moment? Am I finally the main character?

stirfry.line: Stirfry. Yeah. Broccoli probably would've gotten a higher score. Whatever.

salad.line: Salad. Sure. Everyone always picks the leafy one. I get it.

smoothie.line: WHY does everyone want to blend me?? I have FEELINGS and a CAULIFLOWER EAR.

burger.line: A cauliflower bun? Again? Everyone treats me like a bread substitute. I'm a VEGETABLE.

pizza.line: On pizza?? I mean, I'd do it. Just to watch people's faces.

stirfry.line: A squeeze of me and suddenly everything is BRIGHT. You're welcome.

salad.line: Dressing time! I get to make everything SOUR! My favorite hobby!

smoothie.line: BLEND ME. I was BORN for the blender. I AM the blender's soulmate.

burger.line: On a BURGER? With BEEF? Do you know what I DO to beef? Do you??
